text:
You’re looking to consolidate KPI tracking from several Excel sheets and different sources into one secure owner-controlled reporting place with clearer graphs and shareable sections.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I help teams turn scattered KPI tracking into clean, centralized reporting systems. I have 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization, so I’m comfortable working with messy inputs and organizing them into something reliable and easy to use.

In a past project for Marlowe Furniture, I built a Sales KPI dashboard using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. The goal was to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report built on a star-schema model. That consolidation reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project is very similar in spirit to what you need here: fewer moving parts, one source of truth, and reporting that is easier to understand and maintain.

For your setup, I would focus on creating a centralized entry and reporting structure where your team can manually enter data in one place, while keeping ownership and access control aligned with how you want to share information. Since you’re open to Zapier, I’d be glad to evaluate whether it helps connect the workflow between QuickBooks Online, Field Edge, and your master reporting process, or whether a simpler setup in Excel or Google Sheets would be a better fit. My priority would be making the report clearer, reducing confusion from too many pages and sources, and giving you a structure that is easier to manage over time.

I can also help review the current graph layout and reporting structure so the final dashboard or report is easier for managers to read and use. If needed, I can keep the build focused on manual entry with clean downstream reporting instead of over-automating the input side.

Would you like the final solution to live primarily in Excel or Google Sheets, with Zapier only used where it adds clear value?
